meta.confidence_note: Plan drawing is NOT to a single consistent pixel scale, especially the balcony/left dimension chain. Room interior sizes are taken from owner on-site measurements where available (confirmed), otherwise from the plan's printed labels; connecting walls, doors, windows and fixtures not explicitly measured are visual estimates from the drawing. See plan/02-floorplan-geometry.md section 10 for a full ambiguity list.

ambiguities: Building width: plan's own bottom dimension chain (5.48+3.03=8.51m) omits the ~1.1m Entré corridor confirmed by owner; modeled envelope is ~10.22m wide, ~1.7m more than the plan's labeled total. Unresolved.

Left dimension chain (1.31/1.31/3.47) does not sum to total building depth (8.56m from bedroom column) - resolved by treating these as three independent measurements (recess, Bad depth, living room depth) rather than one continuous chain; the building has a large recess northwest of Bad occupied by Entré/foyer.
